E1245

This captured `Fleet` has no `hosts`.

What

This captured `Fleet` has no `hosts`.

Why

D-JETOS-FREEZE1: fleet deployment is frozen jetos research, but captured fleets still name hosts for later planning.

Fix

add `hosts: { web1: system.<name> }` if this is research capture.
